name: shared-session
description: Share a Claude Code session with a link, or with your team. Teammates join from their own Claude Code and talk to it: one session does the work, everyone sees every turn live, and the host approves what runs on their machine. Sign in with GitHub or Google for teams: your team's live sessions, one press to join. Sharing goes through this project's public server unless you set your own (README: Privacy and the public server).

server.title: Share server
server.description: Leave empty to share through the public server. To use your own, its https address (README: "Host a server"). Joining a link always uses the server in that link.
